description: Oil and Gas Changes In and About a Stream Applications is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by British Columbia Energy Regulator. Point locations indicating proposed applications for changes in and around a stream. Common changes in and about a stream activities include the construction, maintenance and removal of watercourse crossings and crossing structures. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher British Columbia Energy Regulator. Its tags are Application, BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Changes, Changes In and About a Stream. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
